title: From Words to Proverbs: Evaluating LLMs’ Linguistic and Cultural Competence in Saudi Dialects with Absher

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot LLM performance on a multiple-choice benchmark (Absher) covering words, phrases, and proverbs across five distinct Saudi Arabian regional dialects to measure performance disparities between dominant (urban) dialects and underrepresented regional dialects.

Testing LLMs using 'Cultural Interpretation' and contextual usage questions based on regionally specific proverbs and metaphors to identify gaps in culturally embedded knowledge and expose urban-centric or globalized biases in model understanding.
